chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to talk about social integration (traditions and customs of Cameroon) and conflict resolution.

lessons.titreLesson: Participating in Traditional and Cultural Manifestations

objectifsLesson.description: Read simple texts and song lyrics about traditional and cultural manifestations.
Use the simple past tense of regular verbs correctly.
Give, receive, and exchange information about cultural manifestations.
Read simple illustrated stories about socializing with friends and neighbours.
Use the present perfect tense.
Complete and rearrange simple narrative paragraphs about socializing.

lessons.titreLesson: Participating in Conflict Resolution in the Family

objectifsLesson.description: Read role-plays and dialogues about conflict resolution in the family.
Use reciprocal pronouns (each other, one another, one another's).
Participate in role-plays giving advice on conflict resolution.

lessons.titreLesson: Participating in Conflict Resolution in the School Community

objectifsLesson.description: Read meeting reports and short newspaper briefs on conflict resolution.
Use relative pronouns (who, which, that, as well as whom and whose).
Write short narrative and process paragraphs on conflict resolution.

chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to talk about future professional life, participate in leisure activities, and enjoy entertainment products.

objectifsLesson.description: Read short texts and dialogues about preparing for a job interview.
Use passive and active voice.
Fill out information forms about preparing for a job interview.
Listen to radio and television news reports about entertainment products.
Use modals and their equivalent expressions (can to be able to, may to be allowed to, must to have to).
Express opinions, likes, and dislikes about entertainment products.
Read descriptions and flyers about recreational activities.
Use basic phrasal verbs beginning with 'put', 'look', and 'give'.
Exchange information about recreational activities through dialogues.
Read instructions and rules related to practising recreational activities.
Make suggestions (let's ..., what if ...).
Write short descriptive or process paragraphs on practising recreational activities.

chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to talk about the protection of the environment, the fight against endemic and pandemic diseases, and endangered species.

lessons.titreLesson: Prevention of Bush Fires and Felling of Trees

objectifsLesson.description: Read short texts and magazine stories about bush fires and tree felling.
Identify and use noun phrases (countable and uncountable).
Rearrange and write simple paragraphs on the prevention of bush fires.
Read descriptions and guides on protecting endangered species.
Use comparatives and superlatives.
Complete dialogues and fill out simple forms on protecting animals.
Read short texts and song lyrics about fighting endemic diseases.
Use exclamations (e.g., What a ...!).
Share personal experiences and stories about fighting diseases.

chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to talk about gender issues, mutual acceptance, violence, and volunteering for conflict resolution.

objectifsLesson.description: Read short texts and reports on being a victim of gender discrimination.
Use possessive adjectives (my, your, etc.) and possessive pronouns (mine, yours, etc.).
Write simple paragraphs on gender discrimination.

lessons.titreLesson: Participating in Gender Equality Promotion Activities

objectifsLesson.description: Read stories and poems about participating in gender equality activities.
Use universal pronouns (each, all, every, etc.).
Sing songs and recite poems on gender equality.
Read descriptions and instructions on exploring problems of violence.
Use adverbs of degree (slightly, quite, too, very, etc.).
Express thoughts, feelings, and preferences about violence.
Read announcements and illustrations about volunteering for conflict resolution.
Fill out simple forms and write friendly letters to pen pals.
Write simple questions and answers about volunteering.

chapitres.competenceChapitre: The learner can use language to explore ICTs, modern inventions, and worries over ICT illiteracy.

objectifsLesson.description: Read simple texts and brochures about modern inventions (WWW, MP3, USB, WhatsApp, Viber).
Use general revision of speech work and grammar.
Exchange information about modern inventions through dialogues.
Read complaints and stories related to worrying over ICT illiteracy.
Use general revision of vocabulary related to ICT.
Express preferences, worries, and personal views on ICT illiteracy.

lessons.titreLesson: Writing About ICTs and Modern Inventions

objectifsLesson.description: Write short descriptive and process paragraphs on modern inventions.
Write short stories, dialogues, poems, and song lyrics on ICTs.
Write friendly emails, SMS, blogs, and chats on modern inventions.
